A '''dormitory''' existed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. At the time of [[Anakin Solo]]'s[[Time/Legends|time]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], he slept in the dormitory.
